note: Set A attempts to extract beam section properties which Set B omits, but Set A contains misbound labels (e.g., associating B1 with Grid 3) and unsupported quotes. Set B is factually accurate on the hole diameters and radius note it extracts but fails to capture the beam section types entirely. Set B is preferred because it has no wrong claims, adhering to the preference for fewer wrong claims over more claims.
remarks: Both sets suffer from excessive duplication of the hole diameter claims. Set A's inclusion of beam sections is valuable but the execution introduces engineering errors (wrong beam tags) that reduce trust.
